title: "ssoosshd sign"

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in server/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Signer mode runs only the certificate signing component: it consumes signing requests from the message broker (NATS) and publishes signed certificates. This mode requires:
  - NATS broker configured (gochannel is not supported for multi-process)
  - CA private key location (via ssh_key config)
  - mTLS credentials for NATS (cert_file, key_file, ca_file)

No database, HTTP server, or OIDC/LDAP configuration is needed. Use this to isolate the signer from the webserver's attack surface.

## Synopsis

```
ssoosshd sign [flags] [args]
```

Inherited from [`ssoosshd`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/) and its parents.
